cues.text: This blade has a dark past.
It has shed much innocent blood.
You're a fool for traveling alone, so completely unprepared.
You're lucky your blood's still flowing.
What brings you to the land of the gatekeepers?
Someone very dear? A kindred spirit?
A dangerous quest for a lone hunter.
I've been alone for as long as I can remember.
You are closer than you know.

segments.summary: The film opens with credits over shots of a vast, snowy, and mountainous landscape, before focusing on a single small figure trekking across the snow.
events: Opening credits display the production foundation and film project name.
The camera pans over snowy mountain ranges.
A lone, small figure is shown walking through a deep, snowy landscape.

segments.summary: A bald man with a dark beard engages in a brief struggle with the small figure, disarming them before looking down at them in the snow.
events: A bald man with a dark beard approaches the small figure.
The man knocks a spear-like weapon from the small figure's hand.
The small figure falls into the snow.
The man stares down at the small figure.

segments.summary: The small figure is seen trekking through a snowy landscape before the title card appears. Inside a dark dwelling, a bearded man speaks to the small figure while handling a blade.
events: A small figure walks across a vast, snowy plain.
A title card with the word 'SINTEL' appears on screen over the snowy landscape.
Inside a dimly lit, warm space, a bearded man examines a blade.
The bearded man speaks about the blade's dark history and criticizes the small figure for traveling unprepared.

segments.summary: Inside a dim shelter, an older, tattooed man questions a young traveler about their journey through the land of the gatekeepers.
events: The young traveler and the older man engage in a conversation about the traveler's purpose in the land.
The traveler reveals they are on a quest to find a dragon.
The traveler admits to having lived alone for a long time.

segments.summary: A red-haired woman climbs onto a rooftop in a dilapidated town and encounters a small, winged, creature that appears to be injured.
events: A woman with red hair climbs the side of a building.
The woman reaches the rooftop and scans the area.
A small winged creature with a blood-stained wing is discovered on the tiles.

segments.summary: The red-haired woman cares for the injured winged creature, while in a separate dark location, a small figure is tended to by another person.
events: The red-haired woman bandages the wounded winged creature and speaks to it.
A person is shown in a dark room applying a substance from a bowl onto the small figure.
The person tending to the small figure instructs them to sit still.

segments.summary: The red-haired woman and the small winged creature she calls Scales are in a bustling marketplace where she encounters various local people.
events: The red-haired woman interacts with the winged creature in a quiet setting.
The woman appears in a marketplace and calls out to the creature, referring to it by name.
The woman walks through a crowd of people in the market.

segments.summary: The red-haired woman climbs to the top of a ruined structure and encourages her small winged companion to fly.
events: The red-haired woman scales a steep, debris-filled incline towards a high point.
The red-haired woman reaches the top of a ruin, overlooking a vast, desolate city.
The red-haired woman urges the winged creature to take flight by saying "Yeah! Come on!"

segments.summary: The red-haired woman watches as her winged creature Scales flies away from their rooftop vantage point at sunset, calling out its name.
events: The winged creature Scales flies away from the rooftop.
The red-haired woman watches it fly into the sunset.
The red-haired woman calls out 'Scales!'
The woman appears focused and intense as she observes the creature.

segments.summary: The red-haired woman and her small winged companion Scales are seen navigating through different terrains, including a vast desert and a bamboo-like forest, before resting in a rocky area.
events: The red-haired woman walks across a large sand dune.
The red-haired woman moves through a thick patch of tall, thin green stalks.
The red-haired woman sits down to rest in a rocky, sunlit landscape.

segments.summary: A small figure travels through a harsh, snowy, mountainous environment.
events: A small figure walks across a snowy landscape.
The figure uses a staff to aid in navigating the steep terrain.
Snow falls heavily, obscuring the view of the surroundings.

segments.summary: Inside a dim room, an older man with tattoos speaks with the red-haired woman about her failure, revealing her name is Sintel and that she is currently in dragon lands.
events: An older man with facial tattoos engages in a conversation with the red-haired woman.
The man tells the red-haired woman that she has failed.
The man reveals the woman's name is Sintel.
The man informs Sintel that they are in dragon lands.
The man hands Sintel an object featuring an engraved dragon-like emblem.

segments.summary: Sintel watches a large, sleeping dragon from a hidden vantage point in a cavern.
events: Sintel looks out from a rocky outcrop into a large, dark, cavernous space.
The cavern contains glowing, crystalline structures.
A large dragon is seen lying on the ground in the distance, asleep.
Sintel peers around a rock, observing the scene.

segments.summary: Sintel crouches in a cave, observing a small creature that she calls out to.
events: Sintel crouches behind a rock in a dark, cavernous space.
Sintel spots a small, winged creature nearby.
Sintel speaks the name 'Scales' while looking at the creature.

segments.summary: Sintel carefully maneuvers around a large, sleeping dragon within a dark, crystal-filled cavern.
events: Sintel creeps past the large sleeping dragon.
Sintel finds a spot to crouch near a cluster of crystals.
The camera focuses on Sintel's face as she looks toward the dragon.

segments.summary: Sintel finds Scales in the cavern, but discovers that the creature has been killed.
events: Sintel searches for Scales in the cavern.
Sintel finds Scales lying on the ground, dead.
A pool of blood is visible on the ground beneath Scales.
Sintel looks devastated upon realizing the creature is dead.

segments.summary: Sintel stands in the dark cave, looking visibly distressed and shocked by her surroundings. She holds out a hand as particles drift through the air around her.
events: Sintel looks around the cavern with a panicked expression.
Small glowing particles fall from the ceiling of the cave.
Sintel reaches out with her hand while appearing overwhelmed.

segments.summary: Sintel sits alone on the edge of a high, desolate cliff, looking contemplative, before a sudden transition shows her standing in the cave again with an intense expression.
events: Sintel sits on the edge of a rocky cliff overlooking a vast, hazy landscape.
Sintel looks down, appearing to be in deep thought or distress.
Sintel is shown standing in the cave, looking around with a focused, somewhat pained expression.

segments.summary: Sintel stands alone on a rocky cliffside watching the horizon, then lies down as the scene fades to a black screen with credits.
events: Sintel stands on a rocky, uneven landscape with flowers in the foreground.
Sintel lies down on the ground.
The screen fades to black.
Credits appear on screen.

segments.summary: The screen displays a series of text credits over a black background, followed by a final shot of a curved knife resting on a wooden surface alongside some drawings.
events: Text credits for music, character modeling, and environment design appear on screen.
The screen transitions to show a curved knife resting on a dark wooden plank next to several sketches.

segments.summary: The screen continues to display scrolling production credits over a wood-textured background, interspersed with various sketches.
events: A continuous roll of production credits scrolls across the screen.
Various sketches are visible on the screen, including depictions of a landscape, Sintel, and Scales.
The camera pans slowly across the wood surface, revealing items like apples and small wooden objects.

segments.summary: Scrolling production credits continue to play over a wood-textured background, interspersed with various sketches and drawings.
events: Scrolling production credits continue.
Various sketches are shown on a wooden background as the credits roll.

segments.summary: The screen displays a final set of licensing information and organization logos on a black background.
events: Text appears on screen stating the film is licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 and providing the website address.
A series of organizational logos appear at the bottom of the screen.

characters.appearance: A small, indistinct human-like figure dressed in dark clothing.

facts.text: The figure is walking alone through a vast, snowy, mountainous environment.
The small figure carries a long, spear-like weapon.
The bald bearded man considers them to be foolish and unprepared for their journey.
The small figure is searching for a dragon.
The small figure claims to have been alone for as long as they can remember.
The small figure carries a staff while navigating a snowy environment.

characters.appearance: A bald man with a dark mustache and goatee, wearing dark rugged attire.

facts.text: The man is capable in physical combat.
He believes the blade he is holding has a dark past and has caused the death of innocent people.

characters.appearance: An older man with a grey beard, facial tattoos, and wearing traditional patterned garments.

facts.text: The man resides in the land of the gatekeepers.
He is knowledgeable about the lands and refers to the current location as dragon lands.

characters.appearance: A young woman with shoulder-length red hair, wearing a white tank top and a shoulder guard.

facts.text: She has been caring for and bandaging the wounded winged creature.
She travels with or cares for a small, winged creature named Scales.
Her name is Sintel.
Sintel is moving stealthily through a cavern to avoid waking a massive dragon.
Sintel is visibly distressed and panicked in the cavern.
Sintel has a bruise or dark mark on her right shoulder.

characters.appearance: A small, scaly, reptilian-like creature with leathery wings and pale skin.

facts.text: The creature has a noticeable blood stain on its wing.
The creature is referred to as Scales.
The creature is named Scales.
Sintel refers to this creature as 'Scales'.
The creature known as Scales is dead.

characters.appearance: A woman with dark hair dressed in a long, dark gown standing at a stall in the market.
A man with a shaved head and goatee wearing a dark jacket, present at a market stall.
A very large, winged, reptilian creature with dark scales, sleeping on the floor of a cave.

facts.text: The dragon is currently asleep.
The dragon's body is covered in large, dark scales and is sleeping in a cave filled with glowing crystals.
